mapillary.purpose: Street-level imagery. Coverage tiles, image metadata and the imagery itself are all fetched by the OpenMapX server; your browser never contacts Mapillary or Meta.
mapillary.dataSent: Only the OpenMapX server contacts Mapillary, sending the map area being viewed and the identifier of any image opened. Your IP address and browser details are not exposed to Mapillary/Meta.
mapillary.dataReceived: Nearest image ID, image metadata and navigation links, vector tiles (sequence lines + image points), and panoramic imagery.
